name: Small herbivorous cladocerans
description: Small filter-feeding water fleas. Functional group pooling three source taxa - Bosmina longirostris, Diaphanosoma leuchtenbergianum and Holopedium gibberum - which in the source web feed only on phytoplankton; they are pooled following the herbivorous-cladoceran guild of the limnological literature, with Daphnia kept separate because of its central role in the cascade.
